intent: Grouped page block with optional heading, description, and actions. Unframed: no fill, radius, border, shadow, or box padding — Card owns the framed surface; layout-content owns page inset. Pass collapsible for a chevron that toggles the body.
useWhen: Separating metrics, tables, or form groups on a page
Under PageHeader to structure dashboard or settings content
doNotUseWhen: Compact tiles with image or footer — use Card
Form legends and grouped fields — use FieldSet
Modal body layout — keep content minimal inside Modal

eyebrow.note: Short sentence-case line above the title, 12/16 at weight 500. Never uppercase.

title.note: 18/24 at heading weight: the middle of three title sizes (page 24, section 18, card 16).

count.note: A neutral kit Count beside the title, like the number of overdue invoices.

headingLevel.note: The title's heading element. Use 3 or 4 when the Section sits under another heading so the outline stays in order. Looks the same at every level.

size.note: Controls gap under the heading and between stacked sections via space-section tokens. Does not add box padding.

sticky.note: The header sticks to the top of its scroll container while the body scrolls. It takes --section-sticky-bg, default surface.page; set it to the surface behind the Section (surface.card inside a Card).

actions.note: kit Buttons only. One primary per view.

collapsible.note: Default false: static heading, no chevron. True: a 16px chevron before the title toggles the body. Requires title.

requirements: title is a heading (h2 by default, headingLevel 3 or 4) with useId
When collapsible, the control is a button inside the h2 with aria-expanded and aria-controls
count sits outside the heading and is a number, never colour alone

doNot: Do not invent a local Section or SectionHeader
Do not use Section as a compact marketing tile — that is Card
Do not give Section a fill, radius, border, shadow, or box padding — Card owns the framed surface; layout-content owns page inset
Do not use Section as the page title — that is PageHeader
Do not embed one-off metric flex rows — use Scoreboard
Do not compose Accordion or Collapsible for page sections — Section owns collapse
Do not use more than one title size per level: page 24 (PageHeader), section 18, card 16
